title: Malformed or incomplete survey submission shows an error and preserves the user’s answers for retry
description: Verifies that invalid payload scenarios surface a visible error and that previously entered answers remain on the form.

steps.description: Navigate to the Day 8 survey page (use the app’s available navigation to reach the survey page, starting from the first loaded page).
Fill a non-required/free-text field (if present) with "Some feedback text" and leave at least one required field blank.
Verify text "error" is visible or an equivalent visible submission failure message is shown.
Verify the previously entered text "Some feedback text" is still visible in the same field.
Verify the page still shows the survey form (not a thank-you screen).
